_help: FC 27 LE Turbo settings. Edit, save, then run the matching lua\scripts\turbo_*.lua from Live Editor's Lua Engine. Automatic features: set enabled=true, then run turbo_enable_auto.lua (or restart Live Editor). Turbo GUI: with gui.autoload=true (default) it loads by itself and is ready about 20 s after the main menu appears (press F8); it connects to the database when you enter a career, or at once when you run turbo_gui_load.lua. gui.autoload=false: nothing is loaded at launch, run turbo_gui_load.lua in game. Settings changed in the Turbo GUI are kept in turbo_output\gui_settings.json and win over this file. See TURBO_README.md.

job_offer._help: turbo_job_offer: a job offer for your manager from club teamid, made by the game's own job market through Turbo.dll (needs the Turbo GUI running in game). The Turbo window's Managers > Job offers section does the same with a club picker.

manager_rules._help: turbo_manager_rules: job_security = safe | very insecure (locked) | okay | insecure | 0..100 | game (the game's own score again); unsackable = true / false (keep = true: switched on again in every game session). Through Turbo.dll's game calls (needs the Turbo GUI running in game). The Turbo window's Managers > Manager rules section does the same.

manager_move._help: turbo_manager_move: managerid to club teamid (the club's manager takes his old job, or becomes a free agent), or teamid 0 = make him a free agent (a free agent, replacement or the first one, takes his club). Career database edit; never your own club.

player_presets._help: turbo_export_player: playerids -> CSV in preset_dir (empty = extensions\player_presets) + JSON in turbo_output\players; turbo_import_player: file onto playerid, groups = profile|attributes|positions|playstyles|appearance|contract|names|miniface (empty = all)
